name: Secrets Cap Cana Resort & Spa
tagline: AAA Five Diamond · Juanillo Beach · Most prestigious adults escape in the DR
rooms: 457 luxury suites on exclusive Juanillo Beach
best_for: Ultra-luxury couples, prestige, Caribbean's best beach

contact.address: Cap Cana, La Altagracia, Dominican Republic

description: The most prestigious adults-only resort in the Dominican Republic — AAA Five Diamond rated on the exclusive Juanillo Beach within the gated Cap Cana development. 457 suites of unmatched Caribbean luxury. Part of Hyatt Inclusive Collection. Consistently rated the best beach in the DR and among the best in the Caribbean. A quieter, more refined atmosphere than Breathless — attracts mature, established lifestyle couples.
highlights: AAA Five Diamond — highest rating achievable, only one in DR
Juanillo Beach — consistently rated among best beaches in the Caribbean
Located within gated Cap Cana community — ultimate privacy and exclusivity
457 luxury suites — no crowding, intimate resort atmosphere
9.0/10 on Booking.com — among the highest rated DR resorts
Google 4.6/5.0 — top-tier guest satisfaction across all metrics
Preferred Club with dedicated pools, butler, exclusive dining
considerations: Highest price tier in the Punta Cana region ($400–$650/night)
Remote Cap Cana location — 45+ min from airport, limited off-resort options
More refined/quiet atmosphere — less energetic party scene than Breathless
Not exclusively lifestyle-oriented — attracting very high-end general adults
Fewer water sports and entertainment options vs. larger properties

reviews.name: AntigueBlue
reviews.text: My wife and I stayed in the Preferred section in a 2nd floor bungalow next to the preferred pool. The only disadvantage was the steps did not have a handrail — you have to be cautious going up and down! The preferred area is compact so getting to restaurants, pool, lounge and beach is easy. The vibe is low key, perfect to chill and relax. Don't expect a DJ blasting music and a foam party! Maid service was present daily. Staff at the preferred bar and Rosewater were outstanding, particularly Yuleisy, Santa F., Marcia, Glenis, and our butler Carlos.

reviews.name: Danyelaa J
reviews.text: Great resort, very beautiful — staff is amazing. Onsite restaurants' food was ok. Would love to have DJ or music at the pool but overall great resort.

reviews.name: Scarlino
reviews.text: I had an absolutely amazing stay at Secrets Cap Cana this April, and I can honestly say it exceeded all expectations. We stayed in a Junior Suite with ocean view — spacious, modern, and spotlessly clean. What made this experience truly exceptional was the outstanding service. A very special thank you goes to our concierge Ericson, who was always attentive, regularly checking in to make sure everything was perfect. The breakfast buffet was extensive and the beach absolutely stunning.

reviews.name: Ian S
reviews.text: Beautiful Resort. Juan Carlos at Portofino, Ice Cube with entertainment, and our butler Matiel made the stay extra special. Big kudos to the BBQ beach restaurant and team — the food is delicious and everyone is helpful with quick service.
